Paper Name: Sizing and Design of a PV-Wind-Fuel Cell Storage System Integrated into a Grid Considering the Uncertainty of Load Demand Using the Marine Predators Algorithm
NOTES: System: grid-connected PV/WT/FC/EL/H2 tank/converter configuration (no diesel generator). Multiple cases: Case 1 (no load uncertainty, MPA optimal) used for primary extraction; Case 2 (+5%,+10%,+15% load uncertainty with MPA) also presented. LPSP value is negative (~0) indicating zero loss of load probability. PV replacement cost marked as '−−−' (not reported) in Table 1. HHV_H2=39.7 kWh/m² reported instead of LHV (H2_LHV). Single PV panel rated power and single WT rated power not reported. Annual load demand figure referenced but no single total annual value explicitly stated. LCOE not reported; COE reported instead. H2 tank capacity given as mass (150 kg) not count. FC and EL capacities given as total rated power, not unit count. No cut-in, rated, or cut-out wind speeds reported. No hydrogen tank min/max percentage thresholds reported. Grid purchase price = 0.08 $/kWh, selling price = 0.2 $/kWh.
